name: PWR (BEAVRS cycle 1) at hot zero power, built with OpenMC

provenance.model: BEAVRS 3D full core, hot zero power (mit-crpg/BEAVRS, MIT licence), 45 cases of pipeline/openmc/beavrs_cases.py
provenance.notes: Zero-power physics only. Reactivity tables, kinetics, shapes and boron worth come from the transport sweep; the plant (rod speed, scram, thermal masses, heat transfer, instruments, trips) is assumed and labelled so. Isothermal temperature coefficient: the transport model is 1.6 to 2.0 pcm/F too negative against the benchmark measurement (docs/validation/m8-beavrs-hzp-results.md), so temperature feedback is NOT validated. Xenon worth is zero (not computed); no decay heat; no pressure. The shape of the power does not depend on coolant temperature or boron. Several banks in: each bank's worth is scaled by 1 + g(the summed single-bank reactivity of the other banks) (reactivity.rodShadowing, capability rod-interaction-v2, fitted to the three combined sweep cases and the nine path cases of the fourteenth protocol, and to nothing else); it sees only that sum, not which banks or where in the core, so it is valid only along the states it was checked on (docs/validation/m8-rod-shadowing-protocol.md). Checked against 19 held-out cases: 6 within the limits of reactivity (100 pcm or 3 sigma) and power shape (one mean bin), listed in domain.jointChecked. Each listed state covers the boron it was run at plus or minus 10 ppm only (a boron window in domain.jointChecked); the boron x bank interaction is not in the model.

sources.cite: N. Horelik, B. Herman, B. Forget, K. Smith, Benchmark for Evaluation And Validation of Reactor Simulations (BEAVRS), v2.0.2, MIT Computational Reactor Physics Group, github.com/mit-crpg/BEAVRS (MIT licence)
